5842-sketches-new-and-old-part-7.creator: Mark Twain
5842-sketches-new-and-old-part-7.description: A book by Mark Twain. cessary for you to go down in the mines and examine them carefully in detail, and therefore you know all about the silver-mining business. Now what I want to get at is--is, well, the way the deposits of ore are made, you know. Now, as I understand it, the vein which contains the silver is sandwiched in between casings of granite, and runs along the ground, and sticks up like a curb stone.

61614-the-apostolic-tradition-of-hippoly.title: The Apostolic Tradition Of Hippolytus Translated Into Englis
61614-the-apostolic-tradition-of-hippoly.creator: Unknown
61614-the-apostolic-tradition-of-hippoly.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The early Church Orders were systematic manuals of disciplinary and liturgical rules for which the collective authority of the whole apostolate was claimed. They made their appearance in the second century, grew to considerable dimensions in the third, and reached their fullest development toward the end of the fourth century.

arxiv-2011-09260.title: A Privacy-Preserving Healthcare Framework Using Hyperledger Fabric
arxiv-2011-09260.creator: Charalampos Stamatellis \orcidicon, Pavlos Papadopoulos * \orcidicon, Nikolaos Pitropakis \orcidicon, Sokratis Katsikas * \orcidicon, William J. Buchanan \orcidicon
arxiv-2011-09260.description: Abstract Electronic health record (EHR) management systems require the adoption of effective technologies when health information is being exchanged. Current management approaches often face risks that may expose medical record storage solutions to common security attack vectors. However, healthcare-oriented blockchain solutions can provide a decentralized, anonymous and secure EHR handling approach.

arxiv-2103-03172.title: Prediction of mass of η c ​ ( 2 ​ S ) \eta_{c}(2S) using variational method
arxiv-2103-03172.creator: Chandrashekar Radhakrishnan
arxiv-2103-03172.description: Abstract The suitability of using non-relativistic quantum mechanics to investigate heavy quark mesons is illustrated through a study of the charmonium meson. We consider a limiting form of the QCD potential which is a simple combination of the linear and Coulomb potential.

arxiv-2211-15780.title: Nitrous Oxide and Climate
arxiv-2211-15780.creator: C. A. de Lange, J. D. Ferguson, W. Happer, W. A. van Wijngaarden
arxiv-2211-15780.description: Abstract Higher concentrations of atmospheric nitrous oxide (N 2 O) are expected to slightly warm Earth’s surface because of increases in radiative forcing . Radiative forcing is the difference in the net upward thermal radiation flux from the Earth through a transparent atmosphere and radiation through an otherwise identical atmosphere with greenhouse gases.

arxiv-2301-02508.title: End-to-End 3D Dense Captioning with Vote2Cap-DETR
arxiv-2301-02508.creator: Sijin Chen 1 Hongyuan Zhu 2 Xin Chen 3 Yinjie Lei 4 Tao Chen 1 Gang YU 3 1 Fudan University 2 Institute for Infocomm Research, A*STAR 3 Tencent PCG 4 Sichuan University https://github.com/ch3cook-fdu/Vote2Cap-DETR
arxiv-2301-02508.description: Abstract 3D dense captioning aims to generate multiple captions localized with their associated object regions. Existing methods follow a sophisticated “detect-then-describe” pipeline equipped with numerous hand-crafted components. However, these hand-crafted components would yield suboptimal performance given cluttered object spatial and class distributions among different scenes.

arxiv-2308-07357.title: Cornet : Learning Spreadsheet Formatting Rules By Example
arxiv-2308-07357.creator: Mukul Singh, José Cambronero Sanchez, Sumit Gulwani, Vu Le, Carina Negreanu, Gust Verbruggen
arxiv-2308-07357.description: Abstract . Data management and analysis tasks are often carried out using spreadsheet software. A popular feature in most spreadsheet platforms is the ability to define data-dependent formatting rules. These rules can express actions such as “color red all entries in a column that are negative” or “bold all rows not containing error or failure” .

arxiv-2308-10339.title: Production of 180m Hf in photoproton reaction 181 Ta ( γ , p ) (\gamma,p) at energy E γ ​ max E_{\rm{\gamma max}} = 35–95 MeV
arxiv-2308-10339.creator: I.S. Timchenko, O.S. Deiev, S.N. Olejnik, S.M. Potin, L.P. Korda, V.A. Kushnir, V.V. Mytrochenko, S.A. Perezhogin, A. Herzáň
arxiv-2308-10339.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by I.S. Timchenko, O.S. Deiev, S.N. Olejnik, S.M. Potin, L.P. Korda, V.A. Kushnir, V.V. Mytrochenko, S.A. Perezhogin, A. Herzáň. The production of the Hf 180 ​ m {}^{180\rm{m}}\rm{Hf} nuclei in the photoproton reaction Ta 181 ​ ( γ , p ) {{}^{181}\rm{Ta}}(\gamma,p) was studied at end-point bremsstrahlung energies E γ ​ max E_{\rm{\gamma max}} = 35–95 MeV. The experiment was performed at the electron linear accelerator LUE-40 NSC KIPT with the use of the γ \gamma activation and off-line γ \gamma -ray spectroscopy.

arxiv-2311-08354.title: Hierarchical Experience-informed Navigation for Multi-modal Quadrupedal Rebar Grid Traversal
arxiv-2311-08354.creator: Max Asselmeier, Jane Ivanova, Ziyi Zhou, Patricio A. Vela and Ye Zhao
arxiv-2311-08354.description: Abstract This study focuses on a layered, experience-based, multi-modal contact planning framework for agile quadrupedal locomotion over a constrained rebar environment. To this end, our hierarchical planner incorporates locomotion-specific modules into the high-level contact sequence planner and solves kinodynamically-aware trajectory optimization as the low-level motion planner.

arxiv-2312-14886.title: Sample Path Regularity of Gaussian Processes from the Covariance Kernel
arxiv-2312-14886.creator: Nathaël Da Costa nathael.da-costa@uni-tuebingen.de, Marvin Pförtner marvin.pfoertner@uni-tuebingen.de, Lancelot Da Costa lance.dacosta@verses.ai, Philipp Hennig philipp.hennig@uni-tuebingen.de
arxiv-2312-14886.description: Abstract Gaussian processes (GPs) are the most common formalism for defining probability distributions over spaces of functions. While applications of GPs are myriad, a comprehensive understanding of GP sample paths, i.e. the function spaces over which they define a probability measure, is lacking.

arxiv-2403-17886.title: NEURAL EMBEDDING COMPRESSION FOR EFFICIENT MULTI-TASK EARTH OBSERVATION MODELLING
arxiv-2403-17886.creator: Carlos Gomes, Thomas Brunschwiler
arxiv-2403-17886.description: Abstract As repositories of large scale data in earth observation (EO) have grown, so have transfer and storage costs for model training and inference, expending significant resources. We introduce Neural Embedding Compression (NEC) , based on the transfer of compressed embeddings to data consumers instead of raw EO data.

arxiv-2404-17078.title: LAMOST J1010+2358 is Not a Pair-Instability Supernova Relic
arxiv-2404-17078.creator: Pierre N. Thibodeaux 1,2, Alexander P. Ji 1,2,3, William Cerny 4, Evan N. Kirby 5, Joshua D. Simon 6
arxiv-2404-17078.description: Abstract The discovery of a star formed out of pair-instability supernova ejecta would have massive implications for the Population III star initial mass function and the existence of stars over 100 M ⊙ M_{\odot} , but none have yet been found.

arxiv-2405-15020.title: AdjointDEIS: Efficient Gradients for Diffusion Models
arxiv-2405-15020.creator: Zander W. Blasingame, Chen Liu
arxiv-2405-15020.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zander W. Blasingame, Chen Liu. The optimization of the latents and parameters of diffusion models with respect to some differentiable metric defined on the output of the model is a challenging and complex problem. The sampling for diffusion models is done by solving either the probability flow ODE or diffusion SDE wherein a neural network approximates the score function allowing a numerical ODE/SDE solver to be used.

arxiv-2405-16692.title: Planning Robot Placement for Object Grasping Thanks: This work was supported by the Bonn-Aachen International Center for Information Technology (b-it).
arxiv-2405-16692.creator: Manish Saini, Melvin Paul Jacob, Minh Nguyen, Nico Hochgeschwender
arxiv-2405-16692.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Manish Saini, Melvin Paul Jacob, Minh Nguyen, Nico Hochgeschwender. When performing manipulation-based activities such as picking objects, a mobile robot needs to position its base at a location that supports successful execution. To address this problem, prominent approaches typically rely on costly grasp planners to provide grasp poses for a target object, which are then are then analysed to identify the best robot placements for achieving each grasp pose.

arxiv-2409-10203.title: Efficient Milling Quality Prediction with Explainable Machine Learning footnoteinfo This work is funded by the European Union under grant agreement number 101091783 (MARS Project) and as part of the Horizon Europe HORIZON-CL4-2022-TWIN-TRANSITION-01-03.
arxiv-2409-10203.creator: Dennis Gross, Helge Spieker, Arnaud Gotlieb, Ricardo Knoblauch, Mohamed Elmansori
arxiv-2409-10203.description: Abstract This paper presents an explainable machine learning (ML) approach for predicting surface roughness in milling. Utilizing a dataset from milling aluminum alloy 2017A, the study employs random forest regression models and feature importance techniques. The key contributions include developing ML models that accurately predict various roughness values and identifying redundant sensors, particularly those for measuring normal cutting force.

arxiv-2502-00994.title: Weak-Strong Uniqueness and Extreme Wall Events at High Reynolds Number
arxiv-2502-00994.creator: Gregory Eyink 1,2, Hao Quan 1
arxiv-2502-00994.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gregory Eyink 1,2, Hao Quan 1. Singular or weak solutions of the incompressible Euler equations have been hypothesized to account for anomalous dissipation at very high Reynolds numbers and, in particular, to explain the d’Alembert paradox of non-vanishing drag. A possible objection to this explanation is the mathematical property called “weak-strong uniqueness”, which requires that any admissable weak solution of the Euler equations must coincide with the smooth Euler solution for the same initial data.

arxiv-2505-14141.title: Building a Stable Planner: An Extended Finite State Machine Based Planning Module for Mobile GUI Agent
arxiv-2505-14141.creator: Fanglin Mo, Junzhe Chen, Haoxuan Zhu, Xuming Hu
arxiv-2505-14141.description: Abstract Mobile GUI agents execute user commands by directly interacting with the graphical user interface (GUI) of mobile devices, demonstrating significant potential to enhance user convenience. However, these agents face considerable challenges in task planning, as they must continuously analyze the GUI and generate operation instructions step by step.

arxiv-2602-21530.title: Signs of Hamiltonian Circles in Simple Plane Signed Graphs
arxiv-2602-21530.creator: Xiyong Yan
arxiv-2602-21530.description: Abstract . We study which signs can occur among Hamiltonian circles in simple plane signed graphs. Using a face-based viewpoint, we relate the sign of a Hamiltonian circle to the product of the signs of the faces inside it, and we introduce co-Hamiltonian sequences.

europmc-pmc5768160.creator: Wang C, Greene D, Xiao L, Qi R, Luo R.
europmc-pmc5768160.description: The Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MMPBSA) approach has been widely applied as an efficient and reliable free energy simulation method to model molecular recognition, such as for protein-ligand binding interactions. In this review, we focus on recent...

europmc-pmc6593637.creator: Palmqvist S, Janelidze S, Stomrud E, Zetterberg H, Karl J, Zink K, Bittner T, Mattsson N, Eichenlaub U, Blennow K, Hansson O.
europmc-pmc6593637.description: Importance Accurate blood-based biomarkers for Alzheimer disease (AD) might improve the diagnostic accuracy in primary care, referrals to memory clinics, and screenings for AD trials. Objective To examine the accuracy of plasma β-amyloid (Aβ) and tau measured using fully automat

pmc-10615030.title: Seroprevalence of five diarrhea-related pathogens in bovine herds of scattered households in Inner Mongolia, China between 2019 and 2022
pmc-10615030.creator: Mengyuan Xie, Kejia Chen, PingPing Liu, Xiaodan Wang, Yexin Chen, Hewei Shang, Yanru Hao, Peiyuan Gao, Xiuling He, Xiaojing Xu
pmc-10615030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bovine diarrhea is a multi-factorial disease and remains one of the biggest health problems in animal husbandry. The endemic trends of the main pathogens responsible for bovine diarrhea in Inner Mongolia have not been analyzed systematically before. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to estimate the prevalence of bovine diarrhea pathogens found in the scattered households of Inner Mongolia in China.

pmc-10673287.title: The CARE (Curiosity, Attentiveness, Respect and Responsiveness, and Embodiment) Model: Operationalizing Cultural Humility in the Conduct of Clinical Research
pmc-10673287.creator: Sana Loue, Timothy Nicholas, Magdalena Iorga, Beatrice Gabriela Ioan, Bianca Hanganu
pmc-10673287.description: Cultural competence training has been criticized for reinforcing existing stereotypes, ignoring intersectionality and inadvertently marginalizing some individuals and groups. In contrast, cultural humility offers the possibility of transformational learning, requiring individuals to pursue a lifelong course of self-examination. This approach makes authentic engagement with others possible.

pmc-10689215.title: Analysis of Long-Term Medical Expenses in Vertebral Fracture Patients
pmc-10689215.creator: Seung Hoon Kim, Suk-Yong Jang, Kyeongdong Nam, Yonghan Cha
pmc-10689215.description: BackgroundThe objective of this study was to analyze the direct medical expenses of a vertebral fracture cohort (VC) and a matched cohort (MC) over 5 years preceding and following the fracture, analyze the duration of the rise in medical expenses due to the fracture, and examine whether the expenses vary with age group, utilizing a national claims database.

pmc-11313654.title: Eosinophilic Esophagitis and Inflammatory Bowel Disease: What Are the Differences?
pmc-11313654.creator: Hassan Melhem, Jan Hendrik Niess, Susanne M Krug
pmc-11313654.description: Eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are chronic inflammatory disorders of the gastrointestinal tract, with EoE predominantly provoked by food and aeroallergens, whereas IBD is driven by a broader spectrum of immunopathological and environmental triggers. This review presents a comprehensive comparison of the pathophysiological and therapeutic strategies for EoE and IBD.

pmc-11439497.title: Evolution of small molecule-mediated regulation of arbuscular mycorrhiza symbiosis
pmc-11439497.creator: Pierre-Marc Delaux, Caroline Gutjahr
pmc-11439497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) symbiosis formed by most extant land plants with symbiotic fungi evolved 450 Ma. AM promotes plant growth by improving mineral nutrient and water uptake, while the symbiotic fungi obtain carbon in return. A number of plant genes regulating the steps leading to an efficient symbiosis have been identified; however, our understanding of the metabolic processes involved in the symbiosis and how they were wired to symbiosis regulation during plant evolution remains limited.

pmc-11728173.title: Incident Cardiometabolic Comorbidities in Smokers with/Without Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: A Long-Term Cohort Study
pmc-11728173.creator: Beatriz Herrero-Cortina, Aura Maldonado-Guaje, Jorge Rodriguez-Sanz, Ana Boldova-Loscertales, Pablo Cubero-Marin, Marta Marin-Oto, David Sanz-Rubio, Jose M. Marin
pmc-11728173.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Backgrounds: Despite the significant global health impact of cardiometabolic multimorbidity (CMM), our understanding of potential predictors associated with its development in smokers, remains limited. Objective: This study aimed to investigate whether a new COPD diagnosis and the rate of lung function decline serve as predictors for incident CMM (defined as having at least two of the following comorbidities: cerebro-cardiovascular diseases, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and diabetes mellitus) in smokers.

pmc-12733332.title: The Influence of Hydrazo and Azo Bonds on the Conformation of New 4-Methyl-3,5-dinitro-2-(2-phenylhydrazinyl)pyridine and Its Azo Derivative—Structural Properties, Vibrational Spectra and Quantum Chemical DFT Calculations
pmc-12733332.creator: Jacek Michalski, Edyta Kucharska, Iwona Bryndal, Lucyna Dymińska, Wojciech Sąsiadek, Anna Pyra, Radosław Lisiecki, Maciej Ptak, Jerzy Hanuza, Josef Jampilek
pmc-12733332.description: A review of studies has shown that aromatic azo and hydrazo derivatives are used in a wide spectrum of fields, including food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic products, as well as in technical and electronic technologies, which has contributed to the development of new such compounds.

pmc-12890482.title: Gc inhibition preserves insulin sensitivity and reduces body weight without loss of muscle mass
pmc-12890482.creator: Richard Gill, Taiyi Kuo
pmc-12890482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D) are metabolic diseases with increasing prevalence worldwide. Obesity often leads to T2D. Insulin resistance and impaired β cell function contribute to the onset of hyperglycemia. Previously, we reported that ablation of Gc, encoding a secreted protein with a primary role in vitamin D transport, improved pancreatic β cell function in models of diet-induced insulin resistance.

pmc-13248985.title: Economic evaluation of stapokibart for chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps in China: a cost–effectiveness analysis
pmc-13248985.creator: Jingran Yang, Lei Ren, Fengyuan Xie, Rong Shao, Rong Jiang
pmc-13248985.description: Aim:To evaluate the cost–effectiveness of stapokibart compared with dupilumab in treating chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) from the healthcare system perspective in China. The focus is on assessing the economic viability of biologic treatments in managing CRSwNP, particularly when conventional treatments and/or surgery fail to provide sufficient relief.

pmc-13546744.title: Identification of a novel and a recurrent CDC45 variant in a Chinese family with Meier-Gorlin syndrome 7 and a literature review
pmc-13546744.creator: Ying Zhao, Yiyang Fu, Shuying Zhang, Yuxin Han, Jinhui Zhu, Wanqi Liu, Shuxian Li, Dan Xiao, Yuan Liu, Lin Wang, Ruixue Zhang, Wenjing Cheng, Kaitao Ren, Xiaorui Zhang, Mingyue Chen, Abdullah, Umm-e- Kalsoom, Nousheen Bibi, Saadullah Khan, Fengni Fan, Ting Jia, Xiangdong Lin, Wei Li, Zhao Li, Gen Ni
pmc-13546744.description: IntroductionMeier-Gorlin syndrome 7 (MGORS7) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder characterized by primordial dwarfism, craniosynostosis, and patellar aplasia, caused by pathogenic variants of CDC45. Here, we report a Chinese patient presenting with classic hallmarks of MGORS7 alongside atypical clinical features, including hearing and visual impairments.MethodsClinical and radiological data were collected.

pmc-13642565.title: Overcoming Computational Bottlenecks in Quantum Hydrodynamics: A Volume‐Based Integral Formalism for Spherical Nanoparticles
pmc-13642565.creator: Christos Mystilidis, Christos Tserkezis, Guy A E Vandenbosch, N Asger Mortensen, Xuezhi Zheng
pmc-13642565.description: Mesoscopic models of the optical response of metals have emerged as fundamental building blocks in quantum plasmonics, in principle overcoming the computational bottlenecks of ab initio techniques by implementing aspects of the atomistic description of the metal in otherwise classical calculations. Nonetheless, even these approaches are eventually hindered by demanding computations due to a sophisticated material response.
